title: Wire `prompthub init --seed` to PromptHub::seed_defaults
objective: INCOMPLETE FEATURE (thin-shell wiring): the core seeding feature is now complete — `PromptHub::seed_defaults(identity)` idempotently registers the six base role templates (done in PHTASK-0029). Surface it from the CLI: add a `--seed` flag to the `init` command (prompthub/src/cli.rs `Commands::Init`) and have commands/init.rs call `hub.seed_defaults()` after creating the store, reporting how many templates were inserted. Upgrade only — wire the existing core method into the CLI entry point; do not reimplement seeding in the shell.
acceptance_criteria: `prompthub init --seed` creates the store and calls PromptHub::seed_defaults
init reports the number of templates seeded
a CLI test covers the --seed path
source: follow-up from PHTASK-0029 (core seeding complete; CLI shell wiring is separate crate scope)
policy_note: Owner directive 2026-06-13: NO DOWNGRADES. Wire the existing core method into the CLI; never reimplement or stub.
resolution: Wired the CLI shell to the core seeding feature (PHTASK-0029). Added a `--seed` flag to the `Init` clap variant (prompthub/src/cli.rs), threaded it through main.rs dispatch, and updated prompthub/src/commands/init.rs run(path, seed): after PromptHub::new it constructs AgentIdentity::local_operator("prompthub-cli") (Read+Write+Admin, the trusted local owner — satisfies seed_defaults' Write requirement) and calls hub.seed_defaults(), printing the inserted count. Pure shell wiring, no core change, no reimplementation (NO-DOWNGRADE). Tests: test_cli_parse_init (seed:false default) + new test_cli_parse_init_seed (--seed -> seed:true). Verified END-TO-END via `cargo run -p prompthub -- init --seed <tmp.db>`: run 1 seeds the 6 base templates, run 2 is idempotent (Seeded 0). Gates: cargo build/test -p prompthub (18 passed) --all-features; clippy --all-features --all-targets -D warnings clean; default clippy clean; fmt --check clean; workspace builds. Done via worktree loop/phtask-0042-init-seed.
